discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the packing polarity becomes a single cfg flip recipe.

discovery_budget.discovery: emit_xv_c still publishes CGO flags that pull the glibc include/link path, so supervisor cells stay green on the builder lane and red on the musl target lane
